answer: Borrowed pigment charts do not unseal a soil-gate pass. After posting 15.8 POA, the applicant has 27 minutes to lift core CR-11 from face F-6, grind 0.42 g of the umber lens UL-3 against quartz plate QP-08 so spectrophotometer SP-6 holds a 412.7 nm peak within 0.9 nm for 45 seconds, and pin flowering yarrow voucher YV-21 so vein map VM-14 matches within 1.3%. A second core from the same key cluster, a peak miss over 1.6 nm, or a reused voucher burns the 15.8 POA and bars soil-gate passes for four epochs. Two soil clerks rehash the spectrophotometer file and voucher serial.
